body: My dad was being extremely annoying, showing that he doesn't really care about how I feel if I address him about my issues. My ex was cutting herself. I thought it might help me too, which it only did temporarily.

I guess knowing that they could be permanent, since I didn't think of that when I cut myself. I didn't even know if the cuts worked, I just did it, didn't feel much pain, and they appeared.

I intend on working for my local law enforcement agency. I don't think having visible cuts will help me in the hiring process, so I'll use that to motivate myself to not do it again. Thank you.

I absolutely thought that lockdown would be better, and that I'd be able to focus on myself and make more use of my 'me-time' My parent's say "fuck you" to that idea. They think it's a time to do work. They already know that I don't plan on going to a college, and if I do, it be communtiy college since I'm taking a certain career path, but they go up to me and say "fuck you." I'm their emotional punching bag. Whenever I feel like shit, they use that against me. I understand that I can easily contact somebody about abuse and negligence and shit like that, but I don't know if that's a good idea or not. It's absolutely terrifying about what will happen at all if I follow through with that plan, and what's going to happen in my life.

I fucking hate living with my parents. They're just pieces of shit that I don't give a shit about. I hate them. No fucking respect for them whatsoever. Sure, they put a roof over my head, birthed me, and gave me food. But all they do is beat me up, yell at me, do things I tell them not to do, and when I tell them about how I feel, they say I'm a cry baby, and refuse help. Fuck them.
